assessment_type: Evidence-based self-assessment, not certification or independent audit
target_context: Enterprise internal shared use over time, with possible real paid business tools; only save plans, no real publishing
scope_note: CLI, SQLite and a native agent loop are acceptable technologies; missing production capabilities are judged for the target context, not automatically defects of the campus MVP.
campus_score_note: Subjective reference for the technical artifact only, not an official exam grade or evidence of independent candidate ability. Mandatory GitHub submission remains incomplete.

dimensions.strength: 题面核心闭环和全部必须验收有证据
dimensions.gap: 只有两个合成产品、两档方案和模板生成，尚无真实运营验收

dimensions.strength: 真实工具观察后重规划、重试或结构化停止
dimensions.gap: 策略空间小，未知任务组合和长期泛化效果未验证

dimensions.strength: 预算/时间/依赖守卫、事务保存、防重复、已有费用保留
dimensions.gap: 费用与耗时是合成值，尚未覆盖真实远端副作用和账单确认

dimensions.strength: 标准库、小模块和公开接口测试，范围控制较好
dimensions.gap: Planner.run 跨 203 行，状态字典与循环、恢复、存储处理耦合

dimensions.dimension: 测试与 AI 效果评估
dimensions.strength: 63 测试、36 组组合子用例、18+2 真实场景，失败归档
dimensions.gap: 最终矩阵每场景一轮；缺少规模充分的独立留出集和重复采样

dimensions.strength: 有限循环、明确失败、保留成功结果、正常失败后的显式续跑
dimensions.gap: 强杀后 running 不接管，未验证备份恢复/迁移或远端不确定结果对账

dimensions.strength: 密钥忽略与扫描、参数校验、认证头不随重定向发送
dimensions.gap: 未验证部署传输保护和安全边界，共享服务身份/授权/数据隔离尚未实现

dimensions.strength: 有真实请求与 Token 统计、缓存避免新调用
dimensions.gap: 正常单样本 27.252 秒；无模型货币预算、并发容量和重复 P95/P99 数据

dimensions.strength: JSONL、run_id、模型/资料版本、usage 和源码指纹
dimensions.gap: 未见持续指标、告警、SLO 或运维处置演练

dimensions.strength: CLI 命令、依赖说明、PRD、测试与真实证据齐备
dimensions.gap: GitHub URL/最终 SHA/CI 与版本发布流程尚未完成，个人贡献和完整工时未补齐

framework_references.name: ISO/IEC 25010:2023
framework_references.use: Product quality reference; no full conformance evaluation performed

framework_references.name: NIST AI RMF Core / Measure
framework_references.use: AI measurement, uncertainty and operational reevaluation

framework_references.name: OWASP ASVS 5.0
framework_references.use: Relevant controls if the CLI is extended into a shared network service; not an ASVS certification

method: Each dimension 0-100. Total = sum(weight * score / 100). Weights and scores are reviewer judgments, not weights prescribed by the cited frameworks.
verification_note: Existing test/trace evidence reused after checking current source fingerprint; no new regression or live inference run is claimed.
release_gates_not_met: Validated recovery and reconciliation for interrupted runs and uncertain paid tool results
Independent repeated evaluations and business acceptance for a defined operational scope
Deployment security boundaries and access controls appropriate to shared use
Versioned release, automated regression, backup/restore and operational monitoring
